h: Wallonia consults on a professional soil quality index
a: The Walloon soil protection directorate opened a consultation with soil-management stakeholders on the professional version of its soil quality index (IQSW-pro).

h: Council sets its position on faster environmental assessments
a: Member states agreed a negotiating position on the proposed regulation to speed up environmental assessments, the permitting part of the environmental omnibus.

h: Permit disputes council halts Ventilus substation works over species assessment
a: In urgent proceedings the Raad voor Vergunningsbetwistingen suspended the permit for extending the Gezelle high-voltage station in Bruges (RVVB.2627.0073).

h: Nitrogen Decree: Constitutional Court ruling not expected before early 2027
a: Practitioner reporting in August indicates the Court will not rule on the challenges to the Flemish Stikstofdecreet before early 2027 at the earliest.

h: Court of Justice: no valid appropriate assessment without site-specific conservation objectives
a: In joined cases C-27/25 Knocknamona and C-356/25 Massey the Court held that a full appropriate assessment under the Habitats Directive must be based on objectives set for the specific site.

h: Constitutional Court upholds Flemish watercourse protection strips, with a reservation
a: Judgment 92/2026 rejects the challenge to mandatory protection strips along watercourses introduced by the Flemish decree of 20 December 2024.

h: Brussels 'Urban Shift' proposal would shorten planning permit deadlines
a: A proposal for an ordinance tabled in the Brussels Parliament would reform the planning code (CoBAT) to speed up permits and give municipalities more room.

h: Constitutional Court annuls Walloon citizen-participation duty for wind projects
a: Judgment 82/2026 strikes down articles 5 and 6 of the Walloon decree of 29 April 2024, which amended the environmental permit decree.

h: Wallonia: earth-quality reports for communal deposits due on Walterre by 30 October 2026
a: The exceptional regularisation of communal earth deposits requires an earth-quality report filed on the Walterre platform by 30 October 2026.

h: Revised Industrial Emissions Directive: transposition due July 2026 despite the omnibus
a: Member states had to transpose Directive (EU) 2024/1785 by July 2026; the Commission told delegations the pending omnibus does not postpone that.

h: Flemish draft decree would make parent companies answer for soil remediation
a: The Flemish Government approved a draft amendment to the Bodemdecreet that lets a parent company be designated as co-obligee when a subsidiary cannot fund remediation.

h: Environmental omnibus: Council position on industrial emissions
a: The Council agreed its negotiating position on simplifying rules for industrial emissions, the circular economy and geospatial data (Omnibus VIII).

h: Chemicals omnibus: provisional deal on classification, labelling and packaging
a: Council and Parliament reached a provisional agreement on simplifying the rules for classifying, labelling and packaging chemicals, the remaining part of Omnibus VI.

h: Flanders: preliminary draft decree for the modular environmental permit procedure
a: The Flemish Government approved in principle a preliminary draft decree amending several decrees in view of the modular permit procedure.

h: Constitutional Court upholds the Walloon subsoil resources code
a: Judgment 68/2026 dismisses the action against the Walloon code on managing subsoil resources, adopted by decree of 14 March 2024.

h: Constitutional Court annuls data-processing article of Flemish water and manure decree
a: Judgment 58/2026 annuls article 8 of the Flemish decree of 20 December 2024 because the data protection authority was not consulted.

h: Constitutional Court: Walloon soil decree cannot deny exemption to a permit transferee when a solvent transferor polluted
a: Judgment 50/2026 finds article 30 of the Walloon soil decree of 1 March 2018 contrary to equality in so far as it bars such an exemption.

h: Constitutional Court partly annuls Walloon rules on permits of unlimited duration
a: Judgment 53/2026 reviews the Walloon decree of 25 April 2024, which makes environmental permits valid for the life of the operation with conditions updated every twenty years.

h: Permit disputes council annuls the Ostend airport permit
a: The Raad voor Vergunningsbetwistingen annulled the environmental permit the Flemish Government renewed for Ostend airport in October 2024.

h: Court of Justice accepts a three-month time limit for challenging species derogation licences
a: In C-58/24 the Court held that EU law does not preclude a three-month limit for annulment actions, running from when the public knew or could have known of the licence.
u: EU Fundamental Rights Agency case note

h: Brussels circular applies the court-ordered brake on building over open sites above 0.5 ha
a: The Brussels Government adopted a circular (Moniteur belge, 10 April 2026) on how the judgment of 29 October 2025 applies to permit applications.

h: Flemish enforcement framework decree now governs environmental enforcement
a: Since 1 April 2026 the Kaderdecreet Vlaamse Handhaving applies to environmental, nature and spatial planning enforcement in Flanders.

h: Walloon programme decree amends the spatial planning code (CoDT)
a: The décret-programme of 26 March 2026 (Moniteur belge, 21 April) changes the CoDT with effect from 1 April 2026.

h: EU updates the pollutant lists for surface water and groundwater
a: Parliament completed adoption on 26 March 2026 of the directive amending the Water Framework, Groundwater and Environmental Quality Standards Directives; the Council had approved it on 17 February.

h: Portugal fined EUR 10 million for not complying with a Habitats Directive judgment
a: In C-613/24 the Court of Justice ordered Portugal to pay for failing to give effect to a 2019 judgment on special areas of conservation.

h: Flanders widens planning permit exemptions and drops most notifications
a: New exemption rules have applied since 1 March 2026: works with limited spatial impact are exempt, and the notification category applied until the end of February.

h: Bodemdecreet amended: guide values may follow what is reasonably achievable
a: The amending decree of 27 February 2026, adopted by the Flemish Parliament on 25 February, entered into force on 23 March 2026.

h: Court of Justice on road projects and the ban on disturbing wild birds
a: In C-131/24 VIRUS the Court clarified article 5(d) of the Birds Directive for a road project challenged in Austria.

h: Brussels government programme: one planning body and a merged permit on the horizon
a: The new Brussels Government's policy declaration of 13 February 2026 announces a 'Bruxelles Urbanisme' directorate merging planning and permit services from 2026.

h: Wallonia prepares digital environmental permits; some procedural changes already apply
a: A Walloon Government order of 22 January 2026 (Moniteur belge, 12 February) fixes 1 January 2027 for electronic permit procedures in all municipalities.

h: Environmental omnibus reaches Parliament's environment committee
a: The ENVI committee held its first exchange with the Environment Commissioner on the six-proposal omnibus the Commission tabled on 10 December 2025.

h: Permit decision period can be extended twice, permit disputes council now accepts
a: In RvVb-A-2526-0381 the Raad voor Vergunningsbetwistingen held that two extensions of the decision period for an environmental permit can be combined.

h: Background: EU Soil Monitoring Law in force, transposition due December 2028
a: Directive (EU) 2025/2360 on soil monitoring and resilience entered into force on 16 December 2025; member states have until mid-December 2028 to transpose it.

h: Commission tables the environmental omnibus
a: The Commission proposed six legislative texts to simplify environmental law on industrial emissions, the circular economy, environmental assessments and geospatial data.

h: Flanders repairs the m.e.r. screening rules and modernises impact assessment
a: A new decree of 21 November 2025 replaces the one the Constitutional Court annulled, and the modernised impact assessment rules took effect on 1 December 2025.

h: Brussels court orders a brake on building over open sites above 0.5 ha
a: The French-speaking court of first instance ordered the Region to suspend urbanisation and soil sealing of undeveloped sites over 0.5 hectare until the regional land-use plan is amended, and until 31 December 2026 at the latest.

h: Permit for apartments in Niel annulled over the water assessment
a: The Raad voor Vergunningsbetwistingen (A/2526/0097) annulled a permit because the effects on water had been assessed insufficiently.

h: Constitutional Court: municipalities and provinces cannot permit their own screening projects
a: Judgment 122/2025 annuls the Flemish decree of 19 April 2024 and confirms that applicant and assessor must be strictly separate for projects subject to EIA screening.

h: Flanders agrees a new temporary PFAS framework for soil materials
a: The Flemish Government agreed a new temporary framework for using PFAS-containing soil materials, pending a definitive one; the rules approved in July 2023 never entered into force.

h: Court of Justice: the conflict-of-interest rule in EIA also covers screening
a: In C-236/24 Provincie Oost-Vlaanderen and Sogent the Court held that the ban on conflicts of interest applies when an authority screens its own project.

h: Co-financing for PFAS soil investigations after firefighting
a: A VLAREBO amendment approved on 6 December 2024 and published on 13 January 2025 introduces co-financing for descriptive soil investigations into PFAS contamination caused by firefighting and fire drills.

h: Flemish decree introduces protection strips along watercourses
a: The decree of 20 December 2024 amends the integrated water policy and manure decrees and creates mandatory strips of three or five metres along watercourses, phased in from 2025 and 2026.

h: Recast Air Quality Directive adopted
a: Directive (EU) 2024/2881 sets stricter EU air quality standards for 2030.

h: Nature Restoration Regulation in force
a: The regulation entered into force on 18 August 2024; each member state has to submit a national restoration plan in 2026.

h: Revised Industrial Emissions Directive in force
a: Directive (EU) 2024/1785 was published on 15 July 2024 and entered into force on 4 August 2024, with transposition due by 1 July 2026.

h: Brussels adds PFAS to its soil intervention and remediation standards
a: An order of 30 May 2024 (Moniteur belge, 9 July 2024) amends the 2018 order on intervention and remediation standards to include PFAS.

h: Wallonia: permits without an end date, and a participation duty for wind projects
a: Two decrees of 25 and 29 April 2024 amended the environmental permit decree: permits become valid for the life of the operation with conditions updated every twenty years, and wind developers had to offer participation to citizens and local authorities.

h: Wallonia adopts a code for subsoil resources
a: The decree of 14 March 2024 creates exclusive permits to explore and exploit subsoil resources and also covers shallow geothermal energy.

h: Flemish Nitrogen Decree adopted
a: The decree of 26 January 2024 sets the framework for assessing nitrogen deposition in permit applications near Natura 2000 sites.
